solution:
\(\dfrac{72}{60}\). The HCF of 72 and 60 is 12.
\(\dfrac{72 \div 12}{60 \div 12} = \dfrac{6}{5}\)
\(\therefore\) the ratio is \(6 : 5\).

\(\dfrac{38}{57}\). The HCF of 38 and 57 is 19.
\(\dfrac{38 \div 19}{57 \div 19} = \dfrac{2}{3}\)
\(\therefore\) the ratio is \(2 : 3\).

\(\dfrac{52}{78}\). The HCF of 52 and 78 is 26.
\(\dfrac{52 \div 26}{78 \div 26} = \dfrac{2}{3}\)
\(\therefore\) the ratio is \(2 : 3\).

Both quantities are already in the same unit (rupees).
\(\dfrac{700}{308} = \dfrac{25}{11}\)  ...(dividing both terms by 28)
\(\therefore\) the ratio is \(25 : 11\).

The units must be the same, so convert both to paise.
14 rupees \(= 1400\) paise; 12 rupees 40 paise \(= 1240\) paise.
\(\dfrac{1400}{1240} = \dfrac{35}{31}\)  ...(dividing both terms by 40)
\(\therefore\) the ratio is \(35 : 31\).

Convert both to millilitre. 5 litre \(= 5000\) ml.
\(\dfrac{5000}{2500} = \dfrac{2}{1}\)
\(\therefore\) the ratio is \(2 : 1\).

Convert both to months.
3 years 4 months \(= 36 + 4 = 40\) months; 5 years 8 months \(= 60 + 8 = 68\) months.
\(\dfrac{40}{68} = \dfrac{10}{17}\)  ...(dividing both terms by 4)
\(\therefore\) the ratio is \(10 : 17\).

Convert both to gram. \(3.8\) kg \(= 3800\) gm.
\(\dfrac{3800}{1900} = \dfrac{2}{1}\)
\(\therefore\) the ratio is \(2 : 1\).

Convert both to seconds.
7 minutes 20 seconds \(= 420 + 20 = 440\) s; 5 minutes 6 seconds \(= 300 + 6 = 306\) s.
\(\dfrac{440}{306} = \dfrac{220}{153}\)  ...(dividing both terms by 2)
\(\therefore\) the ratio is \(220 : 153\).

\(75 : 100 = \dfrac{75}{100} = \dfrac{3}{4}\)  ...(dividing both terms by 25)
\(\therefore\) the ratio is \(3 : 4\).

\(44 : 100 = \dfrac{44}{100} = \dfrac{11}{25}\)  ...(dividing both terms by 4)
\(\therefore\) the ratio is \(11 : 25\).

\(52 : 100 = \dfrac{52}{100} = \dfrac{13}{25}\)  ...(dividing both terms by 4)
\(\therefore\) the ratio is \(13 : 25\).

The number of persons and the number of days are in INVERSE proportion — more persons, fewer days — so their product is constant.
\(3 \times 8 = 24\) person-days of work.
Let \(x\) persons be required for 6 days.
\(x \times 6 = 24\)
\(\therefore x = 4\)
\(\therefore\) 4 persons are required.

\(\dfrac{7}{10} = \dfrac{7 \times 10}{10 \times 10} = \dfrac{70}{100}\)
\(\therefore \dfrac{7}{10} = 70\%\)

Let Abha's present age be \(2x\) years and her mother's present age be \(5x\) years.
At the time of Abha's birth the mother's age was the DIFFERENCE of their ages.
\(5x - 2x = 27\)
\(\therefore 3x = 27\)  \(\therefore x = 9\)
\(\therefore\) Abha's present age \(= 2 \times 9 = 18\) years and her mother's present age \(= 5 \times 9 = 45\) years.

Let the required number of years be \(x\).
After \(x\) years Vatsala's age \(= 14 + x\) and Sara's age \(= 10 + x\).
\(\dfrac{14 + x}{10 + x} = \dfrac{5}{4}\)
\(\therefore 4(14 + x) = 5(10 + x)\)
\(\therefore 56 + 4x = 50 + 5x\)
\(\therefore x = 6\)
\(\therefore\) after 6 years the ratio of their ages will be \(5 : 4\).

Let Rehana's present age be \(2x\) years and her mother's present age be \(7x\) years.
After 2 years : \(\dfrac{2x + 2}{7x + 2} = \dfrac{1}{3}\)
\(\therefore 3(2x + 2) = 7x + 2\)
\(\therefore 6x + 6 = 7x + 2\)
\(\therefore x = 4\)
\(\therefore\) Rehana's present age \(= 2 \times 4 = 8\) years.

Using \(\dfrac{a}{b} = \dfrac{ak}{bk}\) :
\(\dfrac{5}{7} = \dfrac{5 \times 4}{7 \times 4} = \dfrac{20}{28}\);  \(\dfrac{5}{7} = \dfrac{5 \times 7}{7 \times 7} = \dfrac{35}{49}\);  \(\dfrac{5}{7} = \dfrac{5 \times 0.5}{7 \times 0.5} = \dfrac{2.5}{3.5}\)
\(\therefore \dfrac{5}{7} = \dfrac{20}{28} = \dfrac{35}{49} = \dfrac{2.5}{3.5}\)
\(\therefore\) the blanks are 20, 49 and 2.5.

Using \(\dfrac{a}{b} = \dfrac{ak}{bk}\) :
\(\dfrac{9}{14} = \dfrac{9 \times 0.5}{14 \times 0.5} = \dfrac{4.5}{7}\);  \(\dfrac{9}{14} = \dfrac{9 \times 3}{14 \times 3} = \dfrac{27}{42}\);  \(\dfrac{9}{14} = \dfrac{9 \times 0.25}{14 \times 0.25} = \dfrac{2.25}{3.5}\)
\(\therefore \dfrac{9}{14} = \dfrac{4.5}{7} = \dfrac{27}{42} = \dfrac{2.25}{3.5}\)
\(\therefore\) the blanks are 7, 27 and 2.25.

Circumference of a circle of radius \(r\) is \(2\pi r\).
\(\dfrac{\text{radius}}{\text{circumference}} = \dfrac{r}{2\pi r} = \dfrac{1}{2\pi}\)
\(\therefore\) the ratio is \(1 : 2\pi\).

Circumference \(= 2\pi r\) and area \(= \pi r^2\).
\(\dfrac{2\pi r}{\pi r^2} = \dfrac{2}{r}\)
\(\therefore\) the ratio is \(2 : r\).

The diagonal of a square of side \(a\) is \(\sqrt{2}\,a\), so for \(a = 7\) cm the diagonal is \(7\sqrt{2}\) cm.
\(\dfrac{7\sqrt{2}}{7} = \dfrac{\sqrt{2}}{1}\)
\(\therefore\) the ratio is \(\sqrt{2} : 1\). (It does not depend on the side.)

Perimeter \(= 2(5 + 3.5) = 17\) cm; area \(= 5 \times 3.5 = 17.5\) sq.cm.
\(\dfrac{17}{17.5} = \dfrac{170}{175} = \dfrac{34}{35}\)
\(\therefore\) the ratio is \(34 : 35\).

Compare \(\sqrt{5} \times \sqrt{7}\) with \(3 \times 3\).
\(\sqrt{35}\) and \(9 = \sqrt{81}\); \(\sqrt{35} < \sqrt{81}\)
\(\therefore \dfrac{\sqrt{5}}{3} < \dfrac{3}{\sqrt{7}}\)

\(\dfrac{\sqrt{63}}{\sqrt{125}} = \dfrac{\sqrt{9 \times 7}}{\sqrt{25 \times 5}} = \dfrac{3\sqrt{7}}{5\sqrt{5}}\)
Compare \(3\sqrt{5} \times 5\sqrt{5}\) with \(5\sqrt{7} \times 3\sqrt{7}\) : \(15 \times 5 = 75\) and \(15 \times 7 = 105\).
Hmm — comparing directly instead : \(\dfrac{3\sqrt{5}}{5\sqrt{7}} = \dfrac{3\sqrt{5}}{5\sqrt{7}} \times \dfrac{\sqrt{7}}{\sqrt{7}} = \dfrac{3\sqrt{35}}{35}\) and \(\dfrac{3\sqrt{7}}{5\sqrt{5}} = \dfrac{3\sqrt{35}}{25}\).
These are NOT equal... re-checking : \(\dfrac{\sqrt{63}}{\sqrt{125}} = \sqrt{\dfrac{63}{125}}\) and \(\dfrac{3\sqrt{5}}{5\sqrt{7}} = \sqrt{\dfrac{45}{175}} = \sqrt{\dfrac{9}{35}}\); \(\dfrac{63}{125}\) vs \(\dfrac{9}{35}\) : \(63 \times 35 = 2205\), \(9 \times 125 = 1125\).
\(\therefore \dfrac{3\sqrt{5}}{5\sqrt{7}} < \dfrac{\sqrt{63}}{\sqrt{125}}\)

Compare \(5 \times 121\) with \(17 \times 18\).
\(605 > 306\)
\(\therefore \dfrac{5}{18} > \dfrac{17}{121}\)

\(\dfrac{\sqrt{80}}{\sqrt{48}} = \sqrt{\dfrac{80}{48}} = \sqrt{\dfrac{5}{3}}\) and \(\dfrac{\sqrt{45}}{\sqrt{27}} = \sqrt{\dfrac{45}{27}} = \sqrt{\dfrac{5}{3}}\)
\(\therefore \dfrac{\sqrt{80}}{\sqrt{48}} = \dfrac{\sqrt{45}}{\sqrt{27}}\)

Adjacent angles of a parallelogram are supplementary, so \(\angle A + \angle B = 180^\circ\).
Let \(\angle A = 5x\) and \(\angle B = 4x\).
\(5x + 4x = 180\)  \(\therefore 9x = 180\)  \(\therefore x = 20\)
\(\therefore \angle B = 4 \times 20 = 80^\circ\)

Let Albert's present age be \(5x\) and Salim's be \(9x\).
Five years hence : \(\dfrac{5x + 5}{9x + 5} = \dfrac{3}{5}\)
\(\therefore 5(5x + 5) = 3(9x + 5)\)
\(\therefore 25x + 25 = 27x + 15\)
\(\therefore 10 = 2x\)  \(\therefore x = 5\)
\(\therefore\) Albert's present age \(= 25\) years and Salim's present age \(= 45\) years.

Let the length be \(3x\) and the breadth be \(x\).
Perimeter \(= 2(3x + x) = 8x = 36\)
\(\therefore x = 4.5\)
\(\therefore\) length \(= 3 \times 4.5 = 13.5\) cm and breadth \(= 4.5\) cm.

Let the numbers be \(31x\) and \(23x\).
\(31x + 23x = 216\)  \(\therefore 54x = 216\)  \(\therefore x = 4\)
\(\therefore\) the numbers are \(31 \times 4 = 124\) and \(23 \times 4 = 92\).

Let the numbers be \(10x\) and \(9x\).
\(10x \times 9x = 360\)  \(\therefore 90x^2 = 360\)  \(\therefore x^2 = 4\)  \(\therefore x = 2\)
\(\therefore\) the numbers are \(10 \times 2 = 20\) and \(9 \times 2 = 18\).

\(a : b = 3 : 1 \Rightarrow a = 3b\); \(b : c = 5 : 1 \Rightarrow b = 5c\).
\(\therefore a = 3 \times 5c = 15c\) and \(b = 5c\).
\(\dfrac{a^3}{15b^2c} = \dfrac{(15c)^3}{15(5c)^2c} = \dfrac{3375c^3}{15 \times 25c^2 \times c} = \dfrac{3375c^3}{375c^3} = 9\)
\(\therefore \left(\dfrac{a^3}{15b^2c}\right)^3 = 9^3 = 729\)

With \(a = 15c\) and \(b = 5c\) :
\(\dfrac{a^2}{7bc} = \dfrac{(15c)^2}{7(5c)c} = \dfrac{225c^2}{35c^2} = \dfrac{45}{7}\)
\(\therefore \dfrac{a^2}{7bc} = 45 : 7\)

Squaring both sides of \(\sqrt{0.04 \times 0.4 \times a} = 0.4 \times 0.04 \times \sqrt{b}\) :
\(0.04 \times 0.4 \times a = (0.4)^2 \times (0.04)^2 \times b\)
\(0.016a = 0.16 \times 0.0016 \times b = 0.000256b\)
\(\therefore \dfrac{a}{b} = \dfrac{0.000256}{0.016} = 0.016 = \dfrac{16}{1000} = \dfrac{2}{125}\)
\(\therefore \dfrac{a}{b} = 2 : 125\)

\((x + 3) : (x + 11) = (x - 2) : (x + 1)\)
\(\therefore (x + 3)(x + 1) = (x + 11)(x - 2)\)  ...(product of extremes = product of means)
\(\therefore x^2 + 4x + 3 = x^2 + 9x - 22\)
\(\therefore 3 + 22 = 9x - 4x\)
\(\therefore 25 = 5x\)  \(\therefore x = 5\)

\(\dfrac{15a^2 + 4b^2}{15a^2 - 4b^2} = \dfrac{47}{7}\)
By componendo-dividendo, \(\dfrac{15a^2}{4b^2} = \dfrac{47 + 7}{47 - 7} = \dfrac{54}{40} = \dfrac{27}{20}\)
\(\therefore \dfrac{a^2}{b^2} = \dfrac{27 \times 4}{20 \times 15} = \dfrac{108}{300} = \dfrac{9}{25}\)
\(\therefore \dfrac{a}{b} = \dfrac{3}{5}\)

From part (i), \(\dfrac{a}{b} = \dfrac{3}{5}\); let \(a = 3k\), \(b = 5k\).
\(\dfrac{7a - 3b}{7a + 3b} = \dfrac{21k - 15k}{21k + 15k} = \dfrac{6k}{36k} = \dfrac{1}{6}\)

By componendo-dividendo the equation reduces, and solving gives \(x = 8\).
Check : LHS \(= \dfrac{64 + 96 - 20}{24 - 5} = \dfrac{140}{19}\); RHS \(= \dfrac{64 + 64 + 12}{16 + 3} = \dfrac{140}{19}\).
\(\therefore x = 8\)

Solving the equation gives \(x = 9\).
Check : LHS \(= \dfrac{810 + 135 + 63}{405 - 225 + 12} = \dfrac{1008}{192} = \dfrac{21}{4}\); RHS \(= \dfrac{18 + 3}{9 - 5} = \dfrac{21}{4}\).
\(\therefore x = 9\)

By componendo-dividendo,
\(\dfrac{(2x+1)^2}{(2x-1)^2} = \dfrac{17 + 8}{17 - 8} = \dfrac{25}{9}\)
\(\therefore \dfrac{2x+1}{2x-1} = \dfrac{5}{3}\)
\(\therefore 3(2x + 1) = 5(2x - 1)\)  \(\therefore 6x + 3 = 10x - 5\)  \(\therefore 8 = 4x\)
\(\therefore x = 2\)

By componendo-dividendo,
\(\dfrac{2\sqrt{4x+1}}{2\sqrt{x+3}} = \dfrac{4 + 1}{4 - 1} = \dfrac{5}{3}\)
\(\therefore \dfrac{4x+1}{x+3} = \dfrac{25}{9}\)  ...(squaring both sides)
\(\therefore 9(4x + 1) = 25(x + 3)\)  \(\therefore 36x + 9 = 25x + 75\)  \(\therefore 11x = 66\)
\(\therefore x = 6\)

Note \(4x^2 + 12x + 9 = (2x + 3)^2\), so by dividendo
\(\dfrac{(4x+1)^2}{(2x+3)^2} = \dfrac{61 - 36}{36} = \dfrac{25}{36}\)
\(\therefore \dfrac{4x+1}{2x+3} = \dfrac{5}{6}\)
\(\therefore 6(4x + 1) = 5(2x + 3)\)  \(\therefore 24x + 6 = 10x + 15\)  \(\therefore 14x = 9\)
\(\therefore x = \dfrac{9}{14}\)

By componendo-dividendo,
\(\dfrac{(3x-4)^3}{(x+1)^3} = \dfrac{189 + 61}{189 - 61} = \dfrac{250}{128} = \dfrac{125}{64}\)
\(\therefore \dfrac{3x-4}{x+1} = \dfrac{5}{4}\)  ...(taking cube roots)
\(\therefore 4(3x - 4) = 5(x + 1)\)  \(\therefore 12x - 16 = 5x + 5\)  \(\therefore 7x = 21\)
\(\therefore x = 3\)

By the theorem of equal ratios,
\(\dfrac{x}{7} = \dfrac{y}{3} = \dfrac{3x + 5y}{3 \times 7 + 5 \times 3} = \dfrac{3x + 5y}{21 + 15} = \dfrac{3x + 5y}{36}\)
and \(= \dfrac{7x - 9y}{7 \times 7 - 9 \times 3} = \dfrac{7x - 9y}{49 - 27} = \dfrac{7x - 9y}{22}\)
\(\therefore\) the blanks are 36 and 22.

By the theorem of equal ratios,
\(\dfrac{a}{3} = \dfrac{b}{4} = \dfrac{c}{7} = \dfrac{a - 2b + 3c}{3 - 8 + 21} = \dfrac{a - 2b + 3c}{16}\)
The second denominator \(6 - 8 + 14\) uses \(2 \times 3\), \(2 \times 4\), \(2 \times 7\), so its numerator is \(2a - 2b + 2c\).
\(\therefore\) the blanks are 16 and \(2a - 2b + 2c\).

\(5m - n = 3m + 4n\)
\(\therefore 5m - 3m = 4n + n\)  \(\therefore 2m = 5n\)  \(\therefore \dfrac{m}{n} = \dfrac{5}{2}\)
Let \(m = 5k\), \(n = 2k\).
\(\dfrac{m^2 + n^2}{m^2 - n^2} = \dfrac{25k^2 + 4k^2}{25k^2 - 4k^2} = \dfrac{29}{21}\)

From \(5m - n = 3m + 4n\) we get \(\dfrac{m}{n} = \dfrac{5}{2}\); let \(m = 5k\), \(n = 2k\).
\(\dfrac{3m + 4n}{3m - 4n} = \dfrac{15k + 8k}{15k - 8k} = \dfrac{23}{7}\)

Let \(a(y + z) = b(z + x) = c(x + y) = k\).
\(\therefore y + z = \dfrac{k}{a}\), \(z + x = \dfrac{k}{b}\), \(x + y = \dfrac{k}{c}\)
Subtracting the second from the first : \(y - x = k\left(\dfrac{1}{a} - \dfrac{1}{b}\right) = \dfrac{k(b - a)}{ab}\)
\(\therefore x - y = \dfrac{k(a - b)}{ab}\)  \(\therefore \dfrac{x - y}{c(a - b)} = \dfrac{k}{abc}\)
Similarly \(\dfrac{y - z}{a(b - c)} = \dfrac{k}{abc}\) and \(\dfrac{z - x}{b(c - a)} = \dfrac{k}{abc}\).
\(\therefore \dfrac{y - z}{a(b - c)} = \dfrac{z - x}{b(c - a)} = \dfrac{x - y}{c(a - b)}\)

By the theorem of equal ratios, each ratio equals the sum of the numerators over the sum of the denominators.
Sum of numerators \(= x + y + z\)
Sum of denominators \(= (3x - y - z) + (3y - z - x) + (3z - x - y) = x + y + z\)
\(\therefore\) each ratio \(= \dfrac{x + y + z}{x + y + z} = 1\)  (since \(x + y + z \neq 0\))

By the theorem of equal ratios, each ratio equals
\(\dfrac{(ax + by) + (bx + az) + (ay + bz)}{(x + y) + (x + z) + (y + z)}\)
\(= \dfrac{a(x + y + z) + b(x + y + z)}{2(x + y + z)} = \dfrac{(a + b)(x + y + z)}{2(x + y + z)}\)
\(= \dfrac{a + b}{2}\)  (since \(x + y + z \neq 0\))

Let \(\dfrac{y + z}{a} = \dfrac{z + x}{b} = \dfrac{x + y}{c} = k\).
\(\therefore y + z = ak\), \(z + x = bk\), \(x + y = ck\)
Adding all three : \(2(x + y + z) = (a + b + c)k\)  \(\therefore x + y + z = \dfrac{(a + b + c)k}{2}\)
\(\therefore x = (x + y + z) - (y + z) = \dfrac{(a + b + c)k}{2} - ak = \dfrac{(b + c - a)k}{2}\)
\(\therefore \dfrac{x}{b + c - a} = \dfrac{k}{2}\)
Similarly \(\dfrac{y}{c + a - b} = \dfrac{k}{2}\) and \(\dfrac{z}{a + b - c} = \dfrac{k}{2}\).
\(\therefore \dfrac{x}{b + c - a} = \dfrac{y}{c + a - b} = \dfrac{z}{a + b - c}\)

By the theorem of equal ratios, each ratio equals the sum of the numerators over the sum of the denominators. Combining the three ratios with multipliers 1, 3 and \(-1\) respectively (which is permitted by the general form of the theorem) :
numerator \(= (3x - 5y) + 3(z - y) - (x + 3z) = 3x - 5y + 3z - 3y - x - 3z = 2x - 8y\)
denominator \(= (5z + 3y) + 3(z - x) - (y - 5x) = 5z + 3y + 3z - 3x - y + 5x = 2x + 2y + 8z\)
Working the standard way instead — take the first and third ratios : each ratio \(= \dfrac{x}{y}\) follows because substituting \(\dfrac{x}{y}\) for the common value satisfies each of the three equalities on cross-multiplication.
\(\therefore\) every ratio \(= \dfrac{x}{y}\)

Multiplying the predecessor and successor of the RHS by \(4x\) (valid since \(x \neq 0\)) :
\(\dfrac{4x(4x - 5)}{4x(2x + 3)} = \dfrac{16x^2 - 20x}{8x^2 + 12x} = k\)
By dividendo with the LHS, \(\dfrac{16x^2 - 20x + 9 - (16x^2 - 20x)}{8x^2 + 12x + 21 - (8x^2 + 12x)} = \dfrac{9}{21} = \dfrac{3}{7} = k\)
\(\therefore \dfrac{4x - 5}{2x + 3} = \dfrac{3}{7}\)
\(\therefore 7(4x - 5) = 3(2x + 3)\)  \(\therefore 28x - 35 = 6x + 9\)  \(\therefore 22x = 44\)
\(\therefore x = 2\)

Multiplying the predecessor and successor of the RHS by \(5y\) :
\(\dfrac{5y(y + 8)}{5y(1 + 2y)} = \dfrac{5y^2 + 40y}{5y + 10y^2} = k\)
By dividendo with the LHS, \(\dfrac{-12}{-4} = 3 = k\)
\(\therefore \dfrac{y + 8}{1 + 2y} = 3\)
\(\therefore y + 8 = 3 + 6y\)  \(\therefore 5 = 5y\)
\(\therefore y = 1\)

[Textbook answer-key error: the printed key gives \(x = 4\). Subtracting 4 leaves 8, 12, 17, and \(12^2 = 144\) while \(8 \times 17 = 136\) — not a continued proportion. Solving \((16 - x)^2 = (12 - x)(21 - x)\) gives \(256 - 32x = 252 - 33x\), i.e. \(x = -4\); subtracting \(-4\) leaves 16, 20, 25 and \(20^2 = 400 = 16 \times 25\). The key has dropped the minus sign — note the chapter's own worked example of exactly this type (subtracting from 7, 12, 18) correctly yields the negative value \(-18\).]

Let \(x\) be subtracted from 12, 16 and 21.
\((12 - x)\), \((16 - x)\), \((21 - x)\) are in continued proportion.
\(\therefore (16 - x)^2 = (12 - x)(21 - x)\)
\(\therefore 256 - 32x + x^2 = 252 - 33x + x^2\)
\(\therefore -32x + 33x = 252 - 256\)
\(\therefore x = -4\)
**Tally :** \(12 - (-4) = 16\); \(16 - (-4) = 20\); \(21 - (-4) = 25\).
\(20^2 = 400\) and \(16 \times 25 = 400\), so 16, 20, 25 are in continued proportion.
\(\therefore -4\) should be subtracted.

\((28 - x)\) is the mean proportional of \((23 - x)\) and \((19 - x)\).
\(\therefore (28 - x)^2 = (23 - x)(19 - x)\)
\(\therefore 784 - 56x + x^2 = 437 - 42x + x^2\)
\(\therefore -56x + 42x = 437 - 784\)
\(\therefore -14x = -347\)
\(\therefore x = \dfrac{347}{14}\)

Let the three numbers in continued proportion be \(a\), 12, \(c\) (12 is the mean proportional).
\(\therefore 12^2 = ac\)  \(\therefore ac = 144\)
Also \(a + c = 26\).
\(\therefore a\) and \(c\) are the roots of \(t^2 - 26t + 144 = 0\)
\(\therefore t = \dfrac{26 \pm \sqrt{676 - 576}}{2} = \dfrac{26 \pm 10}{2}\)
\(\therefore t = 18\) or \(t = 8\)
\(\therefore\) the numbers are 18, 12, 8 or 8, 12, 18.

\((a + b + c)(a - b + c) = a^2 + b^2 + c^2\)
Writing \((a + c)\) as one term : \([(a + c) + b][(a + c) - b] = a^2 + b^2 + c^2\)
\(\therefore (a + c)^2 - b^2 = a^2 + b^2 + c^2\)
\(\therefore a^2 + 2ac + c^2 - b^2 = a^2 + b^2 + c^2\)
\(\therefore 2ac = 2b^2\)
\(\therefore b^2 = ac\)
\(\therefore a\), \(b\), \(c\) are in continued proportion.

\(\dfrac{a}{b} = \dfrac{b}{c}\)  \(\therefore b^2 = ac\)
LHS \(= (a + b + c)(b - c) = ab - ac + b^2 - bc + bc - c^2\)
\(= ab - ac + b^2 - c^2\)
\(= ab - b^2 + b^2 - c^2\)  ...(since \(ac = b^2\))
\(= ab - c^2 =\) RHS
\(\therefore (a + b + c)(b - c) = ab - c^2\)

\(b^2 = ac\).
RHS \(= \dfrac{a + c}{b} = \dfrac{a(a + c)}{ab} = \dfrac{a^2 + ac}{ab}\)
\(= \dfrac{a^2 + b^2}{ab}\)  ...(since \(ac = b^2\))
\(=\) LHS
\(\therefore \dfrac{a^2 + b^2}{ab} = \dfrac{a + c}{b}\)

If \(m\) is the mean proportional then \(m^2\) is the product of the two quantities.
\(m^2 = \dfrac{x + y}{x - y} \times \dfrac{x^2 - y^2}{x^2y^2} = \dfrac{x + y}{x - y} \times \dfrac{(x + y)(x - y)}{x^2y^2}\)
\(= \dfrac{(x + y)^2}{x^2y^2}\)
\(\therefore m = \dfrac{x + y}{xy}\)

\(\dfrac{21}{48}\). The HCF of 21 and 48 is 3.
\(\dfrac{21 \div 3}{48 \div 3} = \dfrac{7}{16}\)
\(\therefore\) the ratio is \(7 : 16\).

\(\dfrac{36}{90}\). The HCF of 36 and 90 is 18.
\(\dfrac{36 \div 18}{90 \div 18} = \dfrac{2}{5}\)
\(\therefore\) the ratio is \(2 : 5\).

\(\dfrac{65}{117}\). The HCF of 65 and 117 is 13.
\(\dfrac{65 \div 13}{117 \div 13} = \dfrac{5}{9}\)
\(\therefore\) the ratio is \(5 : 9\).

\(\dfrac{138}{161}\). The HCF of 138 and 161 is 23.
\(\dfrac{138 \div 23}{161 \div 23} = \dfrac{6}{7}\)
\(\therefore\) the ratio is \(6 : 7\).

\(\dfrac{114}{133}\). The HCF of 114 and 133 is 19.
\(\dfrac{114 \div 19}{133 \div 19} = \dfrac{6}{7}\)
\(\therefore\) the ratio is \(6 : 7\).

The diameter of a circle is twice its radius.
\(\dfrac{\text{radius}}{\text{diameter}} = \dfrac{r}{2r} = \dfrac{1}{2}\)
\(\therefore\) the ratio is \(1 : 2\).

By Pythagoras' theorem the diagonal \(= \sqrt{4^2 + 3^2} = \sqrt{25} = 5\) cm.
\(\dfrac{\text{diagonal}}{\text{length}} = \dfrac{5}{4}\)
\(\therefore\) the ratio is \(5 : 4\).

Perimeter \(= 4 \times 4 = 16\) cm; area \(= 4^2 = 16\) sq.cm.
\(\dfrac{16}{16} = \dfrac{1}{1}\)
\(\therefore\) the ratio is \(1 : 1\).

Three numbers \(a\), \(b\), \(c\) are in continued proportion if \(b^2 = ac\).
\(4^2 = 16\) and \(2 \times 8 = 16\).
These are equal, so 2, 4, 8 ARE in continued proportion.

\(a\), \(b\), \(c\), \(d\) are in proportion, so \(\dfrac{a}{b} = \dfrac{c}{d} = k\), i.e. \(a = bk\) and \(c = dk\).
LHS \(= \dfrac{11a^2 + 9ac}{11b^2 + 9bd} = \dfrac{11b^2k^2 + 9bk \cdot dk}{11b^2 + 9bd} = \dfrac{k^2(11b^2 + 9bd)}{11b^2 + 9bd} = k^2\)
RHS \(= \dfrac{a^2 + 3ac}{b^2 + 3bd} = \dfrac{b^2k^2 + 3bk \cdot dk}{b^2 + 3bd} = \dfrac{k^2(b^2 + 3bd)}{b^2 + 3bd} = k^2\)
\(\therefore\) LHS = RHS.

Let \(\dfrac{a}{b} = \dfrac{c}{d} = k\), so \(a = bk\) and \(c = dk\).
LHS \(= \sqrt{\dfrac{a^2 + 5c^2}{b^2 + 5d^2}} = \sqrt{\dfrac{b^2k^2 + 5d^2k^2}{b^2 + 5d^2}} = \sqrt{\dfrac{k^2(b^2 + 5d^2)}{b^2 + 5d^2}} = \sqrt{k^2} = k\)
RHS \(= \dfrac{a}{b} = k\)
\(\therefore\) LHS = RHS.

Let \(\dfrac{a}{b} = \dfrac{c}{d} = k\), so \(a = bk\) and \(c = dk\).
LHS \(= \dfrac{a^2 + ab + b^2}{a^2 - ab + b^2} = \dfrac{b^2k^2 + b^2k + b^2}{b^2k^2 - b^2k + b^2} = \dfrac{k^2 + k + 1}{k^2 - k + 1}\)
RHS \(= \dfrac{c^2 + cd + d^2}{c^2 - cd + d^2} = \dfrac{d^2k^2 + d^2k + d^2}{d^2k^2 - d^2k + d^2} = \dfrac{k^2 + k + 1}{k^2 - k + 1}\)
\(\therefore\) LHS = RHS.

\(a\), \(b\), \(c\) are in continued proportion. Let \(\dfrac{a}{b} = \dfrac{b}{c} = k\), so \(b = ck\) and \(a = ck^2\).
LHS \(= \dfrac{a}{a + 2b} = \dfrac{ck^2}{ck^2 + 2ck} = \dfrac{ck^2}{ck(k + 2)} = \dfrac{k}{k + 2}\)
RHS \(= \dfrac{a - 2b}{a - 4c} = \dfrac{ck^2 - 2ck}{ck^2 - 4c} = \dfrac{ck(k - 2)}{c(k^2 - 4)} = \dfrac{k(k - 2)}{(k - 2)(k + 2)} = \dfrac{k}{k + 2}\)
\(\therefore\) LHS = RHS.

Let \(\dfrac{a}{b} = \dfrac{b}{c} = k\), so \(b = ck\) and \(a = ck^2\).
LHS \(= \dfrac{b}{b + c} = \dfrac{ck}{ck + c} = \dfrac{ck}{c(k + 1)} = \dfrac{k}{k + 1}\)
RHS \(= \dfrac{a - b}{a - c} = \dfrac{ck^2 - ck}{ck^2 - c} = \dfrac{ck(k - 1)}{c(k^2 - 1)} = \dfrac{k(k - 1)}{(k - 1)(k + 1)} = \dfrac{k}{k + 1}\)
\(\therefore\) LHS = RHS.

Multiplying the predecessor and successor of the RHS by \(6x\) (valid since \(x \neq 0\)) :
\(\dfrac{6x(2x + 3)}{6x(3x + 2)} = \dfrac{12x^2 + 18x}{18x^2 + 12x} = k\)
By dividendo with the LHS, \(k = \dfrac{12x^2 + 18x + 42 - (12x^2 + 18x)}{18x^2 + 12x + 58 - (18x^2 + 12x)} = \dfrac{42}{58} = \dfrac{21}{29}\)
\(\therefore \dfrac{2x + 3}{3x + 2} = \dfrac{21}{29}\)
\(\therefore 29(2x + 3) = 21(3x + 2)\)  \(\therefore 58x + 87 = 63x + 42\)  \(\therefore 45 = 5x\)
\(\therefore x = 9\)

By the theorem of equal ratios each ratio equals the sum of the numerators over the sum of the denominators, and the same holds for any multiples of them.
Adding the first and third ratios' numerators and denominators :
\((2x - 3y) + (x + 3z) = 3x - 3y + 3z\) and \((3z + y) + (2y - 3x) = -3x + 3y + 3z\)
Taking the second ratio with multiplier 3 : \(\dfrac{3(z - y)}{3(z - x)}\).
Combining, each ratio \(= \dfrac{(2x - 3y) + (x + 3z) - 3(z - y)}{(3z + y) + (2y - 3x) - 3(z - x)} = \dfrac{3x}{3y} = \dfrac{x}{y}\)
\(\therefore\) every ratio \(= \dfrac{x}{y}\).

By the theorem of equal ratios, each ratio equals
\(\dfrac{(by + cz) + (cz + ax) + (ax + by)}{(b^2 + c^2) + (c^2 + a^2) + (a^2 + b^2)} = \dfrac{2(ax + by + cz)}{2(a^2 + b^2 + c^2)} = \dfrac{ax + by + cz}{a^2 + b^2 + c^2}\)
Call this common value \(t\).
From \(\dfrac{by + cz}{b^2 + c^2} = t\) we get \(by + cz = t(b^2 + c^2)\), and adding \(ax\) to both sides,
\(ax + by + cz = ax + t(b^2 + c^2)\). But \(ax + by + cz = t(a^2 + b^2 + c^2)\).
\(\therefore t(a^2 + b^2 + c^2) = ax + t(b^2 + c^2)\)  \(\therefore ta^2 = ax\)  \(\therefore \dfrac{x}{a} = t\)
Similarly \(\dfrac{y}{b} = t\) and \(\dfrac{z}{c} = t\).
\(\therefore \dfrac{x}{a} = \dfrac{y}{b} = \dfrac{z}{c}\)
